added_lines: ANNUAL MASS OF REMEMBRANCE You are invited to join us at the Annual Mass of Remembrance for students and staff of Firhouse Community College, on Monday 23rd November at 7 p.m. In Firhouse Parish Church, Our Lady of Mount Carmel. We would be delighted if you could join us for refreshments in the church afterwards. "Youth 2000 Christmas Retreat | 11th-13th December 2026 Calling all young people aged 16 –35! Join us at the Youth 2000 Christmas Retreat in Newbridge College, Co. Kildare. This is a donation-only event, with free buses available across the country and all meals included. Expect inspiring talks and workshops, Mass, music, prayer, and plenty of opportunities to chill out and meet other young Catholics. Whether you are new to the faith or looking to be refreshed, all are welcome. To register or find out more, visit youth2000.ie or follow @Youth2000Ireland." Welcome to Our Lady of Perpetual Succour – Donnybrook Deanery –22nd November 2026 – The Solemnity of Our Lord Jesus Christ, King of The Universe Email :

– Parish Office Hrs.: 10.30am to 12pm (Mon, Tue, Wed, Thurs, Fri.) Very Rev. Philip Bradley PP, Phone: Paul Kenny – Webcam via Parish Website Webcam – Foxrock Parish (Registered Charity No. 20016166) Mass: Mon, Tue, Thurs & Fri 10am - Sat Vigil 6pm - Sun 10am & 11.30am Confession : 5.20-5.50pm on Saturday in Confession Box or by Appointment. 1 Committee, 2 Parishes I’ve noticed recently, that when I go into a church in town or just a church that I haven’t been in before, I find myself looking at the roof, looking for damp! Then my eye scans the floor, the windows and doors. I may have entered to pray but my Health & Safety brain takes over, followed by building worries and any other problem that might be lurking. I do manage to shift back to the Prayer, but it takes an effort. Foxrock and Newtownpark Parishes have very different churches and somewhat similar Pastoral Centres. And, I find myself looking at (Buildings) management issues. The Dio- cese has recently appointed a Health and Safety Co-ordinator who does a H&Scheck and gives us a report. We have the task of doing our best to remedy any faults. SO, I want to set up a buildings/Health &Safety Committee for both Parishes. No point in inventing the wheel twice. The maintenance of our Churches and Pastoral Centres requires constant work. Prevention is far better than cure. Have you just retired or do you have an inter- est in buildings? Could I please twist your arm to assist in REAL service to our Parish Communities? I need skills and knowledge! I hope to start in the New Year. Fr Philip (A house built on sand….)
